jpn4_groups.I: Not counted by BD/LandsD/PlanD whatever the lease says (PNAP criteria apply)
jpn4_groups.II_nil: Needs a lease GFA exemption clause; nil premium, administrative fee
jpn4_groups.II_premium: Needs a lease GFA exemption clause and premium (standard rates PN 3/2026 for balconies, UPs, external walls; PN 4/2026 MiC)
jpn4_groups.III: Case by case; must be specified in the lease
